cards.ex: Someone tried to break into my car last night, but the alarm went off.
cards.exUz: Kecha kimdir mening mashinamga buzib kirmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin signalizatsiya ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Ruxsatsiz joyga kuch ishlatib kirmoq, o'g'irlik qilish maqsadida.

cards.ex: He thought he could get away with cheating on the test, but he got caught.
cards.exUz: U testda aldash bilan jazodan qutulish mumkin deb o'yladi, lekin u ushlandi.
cards.uzDef: Qilmishiga jazo olmaslik, e'tibordan chetda qolish.

cards.ex: The police have ruled out suicide and are treating it as a murder.
cards.exUz: Politsiya o'z joniga qasd qilishni rad etdi va uni qotillik deb hisoblamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani imkoniyatlar ro'yxatidan chiqarib tashlamoq.

cards.ex: They reopened the cold case after finding new DNA evidence.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi DNK dalillarini topgandan so'ng ochilmagan ishni qayta ochishdi.
cards.uzDef: Yopilgan, ammo hozirda yangi dalillar bilan qayta ochilgan ish.

cards.ex: The mayor is under investigation for corruption.
cards.exUz: Hokim korruptsiya bo'yicha tergov ostida.
cards.uzDef: Biror hodisa yoki shaxs haqida tekshiruv o'tkazilmoqda.

cards.ex: He had to serve time for robbery.
cards.exUz: U o'g'irlik uchun qamoqda o'tirishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda jazo muddatini o'tkazmoq.

cards.ex: After running for a week, he decided to turn himself in.
cards.exUz: Bir hafta qochgandan so'ng, u o'zini taslim qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Politsiyaga o'z ixtiyori bilan kelib, qilmishini tan olmoq.

cards.ex: He only got a slap on the wrist for the minor offense.
cards.exUz: U kichik qonunbuzarlik uchun faqat yengil jazo oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik qonunbuzarlik uchun beriladigan yengil jazo.

cards.ex: The company was accused of cooking the books to avoid paying taxes.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya soliq to'lamaslik uchun buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Buxgalteriya hisobotlarini aldash yoki noto'g'ri ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: He claimed the evidence was planted and that he was a victim of a frame-up.
cards.exUz: U dalillar soxta ekanligini va u tuhmat qurboni ekanligini da'vo qildi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni aybdor ko'rsatish uchun qilingan reja yoki tuzoq.

cards.ex: The jury found him guilty beyond a reasonable doubt.
cards.exUz: Hakamlar hay'ati uni shubhasiz aybdor deb topdi.
cards.uzDef: Sud jarayonida ayblanuvchining aybi to'liq isbotlangan bo'lishi kerak.

cards.ex: He's on parole and has to report to his officer every week.
cards.exUz: U shartli ozodlikda va har hafta o'z ofitseriga hisobot berishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqdan shartli ravishda ozod qilingan, nazorat ostida bo'lgan shaxs.

cards.ex: The police took him into custody after the witness identified him.
cards.exUz: Guvoh uni tanigandan so'ng, politsiya uni qo'lga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Politsiya tomonidan hibsga olinmoq.

cards.ex: He knew he'd have to face the music for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U o'z xatolari uchun javob berishi kerakligini bilar edi.
cards.uzDef: Qilmishlar uchun javob berishga tayyor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: It was a close call, but the police arrived just in time.
cards.exUz: Bu xavfli vaziyat edi, lekin politsiya vaqtida yetib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki noxush vaziyatdan deyarli qutulib qolish.

cards.ex: The detective promised to follow up on the new leads.
cards.exUz: Detektiv yangi ma'lumotlar bo'yicha tekshiruvni davom ettirishga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni yoki ma'lumotni tekshirishni davom ettirmoq.

cards.ex: The judge let him off with a warning.
cards.exUz: Sudya uni ogohlantirish bilan ozod qildi.
cards.uzDef: Jazodan ozod qilish, jazolamaslik.

cards.ex: His behavior was beyond the pale; I can't believe he said that.
cards.exUz: Uning xatti-harakati qabul qilib bo'lmas edi; men uning buni aytganiga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy me'yorlardan tashqari, qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan xatti-harakat.

cards.ex: They tried to cover up the scandal, but the truth came out.
cards.exUz: Ular mojarolni yashirishga harakat qilishdi, lekin haqiqat yuzaga chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror xatoni, jinoyatni yoki faktni yashirishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The suspect is still on the run.
cards.exUz: Gumonlanuvchi hali ham qochib yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Politsiyadan yoki qonundan qochib yurgan shaxs.

cards.ex: They're going to throw the book at him for fraud.
cards.exUz: Ular uni firibgarlik uchun eng qattiq jazo bilan jazolashmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdorga qonun bo'yicha eng qattiq jazoni qo'llamoq.

cards.ex: The email was the smoking gun that proved his guilt.
cards.exUz: Email uning aybdorligini isbotlovchi aniq dalil edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning aniq isboti, dalili.

cards.ex: He decided to plead guilty to avoid a long trial.
cards.exUz: U uzoq sud jarayonidan qochish uchun aybini tan olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sudda aybini tan olmoq.

cards.ex: The robbery happened in broad daylight.
cards.exUz: O'g'irlik kunduzi sodir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kunduzi, hamma ko'rib turgan paytda.

cards.ex: His testimony got him off the hook.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'rsatuvlari uni javobgarlikdan ozod qildi.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikdan yoki qiyin vaziyatdan ozod bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He had to pull some strings to get his son out of trouble.
cards.exUz: U o'g'lini muammodan qutqarish uchun ta'sir o'tkazishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun o'z ta'siridan foydalanmoq.

cards.ex: He agreed to take the fall for his friend.
cards.exUz: U do'sti uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olishga rozi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqaning xatosi yoki jinoyati uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: The prosecutor offered him a chance to cut a deal.
cards.exUz: Prokuror unga kelishuvga erishish imkoniyatini taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Sud bilan jazo masalasida kelishuvga erishmoq.

cards.ex: He's been behind bars for ten years.
cards.exUz: U o'n yildan beri panjara ortida.
cards.uzDef: Qamoqda, ozodlikdan mahrum qilingan holda.

cards.ex: The police had a stakeout outside his house.
cards.exUz: Politsiya uning uyi tashqarisida poyloq o'tkazdi.
cards.uzDef: Politsiyaning biror joyni kuzatib turishi.
